text:
Travis Konecny missed most of October with an injury, and the Flyers felt it. He returned on Nov. 1 with a goal and an assist in a win over Utah, scored again on Sunday in Vancouver, and has 6 points in 10 games. The Athletic's coverage of his return called it the jolt the team had been missing, and he has been loudly defending the Flyers to anyone who doubts them.

The numbers are ordinary so far, which is about right for a player working back. Philadelphia gets 46% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) at five on five with him, though that is almost 5 points better than without him. His scoring rate sits just under the range we'd expect, and his shooting is right at league average.

The worry from last season was defense: Evolving-Hockey had opponents getting +0.17 expected goals per 60 more with him on the ice, bottom 6% of forwards. Our projection is about 52 points in a shortened year. A healthy Konecny matters more to this Flyers team than his first ten games show.
headline: Konecny is back, and Philadelphia needed him
